scope: DEV-ONLY deterministic four-line observation extraction from eight already-used multiscale 2D Helmholtz pilot systems. Each public file contains exactly 780 complex lowband samples plus public source/loss/BC metadata. Public NPZ files omit generator seeds and hidden medium parameters; the local provenance manifest maps opaque ordinal filenames to truth seeds and must not be provided as model input. No target-frequency fields, full-field lowband arrays, or medium maps are included. Not independent test evidence.
